entries.subject: Ďurech & Hanuš (2026), model 1 of (9165) Raup: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: Model 1 of the deposit (version 2026-09-17), pole (285.6°, 56.9°), period 1303.393531 h, taken unchanged from shape_models/model_9165_1.tri. The deposit lists one spin solution for (9165) Raup. It replaces DAMIT model 5835 (pole 269°, 87°; period 46.22 h), whose period the paper lists among those it corrects (its Table 2) and which the LCDB period of 1320 h already contradicted.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 4.839 ± 0.167 km, NEATM effective spherical diameter at the observing geometry. A thermal effective spherical diameter from NEOWISE, given to the mesh volume as an approximate display scale; its quoted fit error excludes about 20% systematic uncertainty.

entries.subject: DAMIT model 5835
entries.finding: DAMIT lists one model for this target, 5835 (version 2019-10-23, pole 269°, 87°, period 46.22 h), which this package showed until 2026-10-06. The Lightcurve Database period of 1320 h contradicted it, and Table 2 of Ďurech & Hanuš (2026) lists it among the DAMIT periods their new model corrects (1303.39 h). The DAMIT exports read on 2026-10-06 still hold only model 5835.
entries.revisitWhen: DAMIT replaces model 5835 with the 2026 model, or lists another model for this target.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: Shown rotation "1303.393531 hours" (doi-10-5281-zenodo-22812438) differs from the LCDB V4.0 summary record 6176 period 1320. h (U 3-, synodic); the shown value is kept.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
